confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates use [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Sarande-Albania), which has relatively few contributors. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect their relationship to beer and [local drink ranges](https://blog.sarandarent.com/albania-travel-costs-2026-how-much-does-a-saranda-vacation-really-cost-daily-budget-breakdown-best-scenery-spots/). July accommodation prices are holistic estimates and are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Saranda is assessed against Albanian coastal destinations such as Vlora, with an allowance for strong July beach-season demand.
